name: What is the difference between kitchen cabinet replacement and cabinet refacing?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between kitchen cabinet replacement and cabinet refacing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cabinet replacement involves tearing out your existing cabinet boxes down to the drywall and installing entirely new units, whereas refacing keeps the structural framework intact while updating just the doors, drawer fronts, and exterior veneers. A full replacement gives you complete freedom to redesign your kitchen layout, expand storage, or fix structural water damage hidden inside the framing. Refacing saves time and preserves functioning layouts, but it cannot fix broken internal framing, uneven shelves, or poor floor plan designs. If your current cabinet boxes are deteriorating or you want to relocate appliances and sinks, replacing the cabinets is the right approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacement removes existing boxes to change layout and fix structural issues, while refacing keeps current cabinet boxes and only updates exterior doors and veneers.
